name: Morph Slider
description: WebGL image slider that transitions between slides with shader effects (melt, ripple, shear, swirl), with drag to scrub, arrows, dot indicators, captions and optional autoplay.
contents: WebGL canvas rendering the current and next image with a transition shader
Caption pill per slide that fades and blurs in
Rounded dark frame filling its parent
behavior: Images are blended in a fragment shader with chromatic aberration, slow idle drift and a soft vignette tinted by overlayColor
Dragging horizontally scrubs the transition progress, release past 40 percent completes it, otherwise it snaps back
Arrow keys, arrow buttons and dots trigger a timed gsap transition
Optional autoplay advances after a delay and pauses while the mouse hovers
Loop wraps around the ends, with loop off the slider stops at the first and last slide
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by dropping distortion effects and shortening durations
Ripple transition starts from the pointer position of the last press

props.name: items
props.default: 4 sample Unsplash images captioned One to Four

editableByProps: Slide images and captions, number of slides, starting slide
Transition style, duration, easing, distortion intensity, noise scale, aberration and idle drift
Autoplay on or off and delay, looping
Corner radius and vignette overlay color
Show or hide captions, arrow controls and dot indicators
Size and extra styling through className, extra props are spread on the root

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow button, caption or dot styling and colors
needsCodeEdit.where: Tailwind classes in the JSX of MorphSlider (showCaptions, showControls, showIndicators blocks)
TRANSITIONS constant and the uMode branches in fragmentShader

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fallback color shown before images load
Change the drag completion threshold or release speed

needsCodeEdit.where: bg-[#0c0c0e] class on the root div

fixed: Root is w-full h-full, so the parent must have an explicit height or the slider collapses
Images must allow cross-origin loading (CORS) since they are loaded as WebGL textures
Needs WebGL support, there is no non-WebGL fallback and slides stay dark until images load
Engine is rebuilt whenever the items array identity or startIndex changes, so pass a stable items array
Captions, controls and indicators have fixed pixel positions and sizes, and aria labels are hardcoded English
Touch scrolling is limited to vertical (touch-action pan-y) so horizontal swipes drag the slider
Usable on small screens as the canvas follows the container size

options.look: Noise-warped dissolve where the next image bleeds through organic fbm blobs
options.useWhen: Hero or lookbook slider for a soft, artistic brand such as a photography studio

options.look: Circular wave expanding from the pointer press position, revealing the next image inside the ring
options.useWhen: Interactive showcase where visitors click or drag and the effect should respond to where they touch

options.look: Horizontal sliced strips that jitter sideways while a wipe sweeps across in the swipe direction
options.useWhen: Tech, music or streetwear landing page that wants a glitchy, energetic slide change

options.look: Both images twist around the center while crossfading
options.useWhen: Product or travel feature slider that wants a dreamy, hypnotic transition
